name: japan-anime-figure-demand-features
title: Japan Anime Figure Demand Feature Vectors
description: Fixed-dimension (48) normalized feature vectors for 650+ Japan anime/figure SKUs, derived from the multi-shop price snapshot of japan-anime-figure-price-data. Purpose-built for AI agents, ML training pipelines and quant research: named features, canonical ordered vector, demand-score proxy and full schema manifest. No scraping at run time.
author: atushi

outputSchema.title: Figure Demand Feature Vectors
outputSchema.description: Per-SKU demand feature vectors (48 normalized dimensions) plus the schema manifest describing feature order and normalization constants.

dataset.title: Feature Vector Dataset
dataset.description: Default dataset: one record per SKU with a named feature dictionary, canonical ordered vector and demand-score proxy.

manifest.title: Feature Schema Manifest
manifest.description: Key-value store record FEATURE_MANIFEST: schemaVersion, featureDim, ordered featureNames, per-dimension documentation and normalization constants.
